title: The body map says nothing was trained when the 30 or 90 day read fails
what: If reading the longer range fails, the body map treats it as no sets and shows 'Nothing trained in the last 30 days', though the member did train.
expected: A plain error with a way to try again, as the muscle sheet already does.
how_often: rare: only when the phone's own data read fails
fix_line: Show a try-again error instead of the empty message when the read fails
